name: compliance
description: Data-subject rights: GDPR / DPDPA right-to-be-forgotten erasure with clinical retention.

compliance.mechanism: Salted SHA-256 pseudonymization of identifiers; sensitive fields nulled.
compliance.retention: Encounters and Claims are never deleted; only Customer PII is erased.
compliance.auditability: Every erasure writes an immutable AuditLog entry (action=ERASURE).
